ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $ \triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$. If $ \angle A = 65^\circ$, what is the measure of $ \angle EDC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC \cong \triangle DEF$, \\
it follows that $\angle EDC = \angle A = 65^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle EDC = \boxed{65^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: First read the diagram: A, D, C, and F lie on the same straight baseline, with D between A and C and C between D and F; segment DE is one side of triangle DEF, so angle EDC is the same angle at D as the interior angle EDF of triangle DEF. From the text, use the congruence statement triangle ABC congruent to triangle DEF. The order of the letters gives the correspondence A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F. Therefore the angle at A in triangle ABC corresponds to the angle at D in triangle DEF. Since angle A is given as 65 degrees, angle EDC = angle EDF = 65 degrees.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中 A、D、C、F 在同一条直线基线上，D 在 A 和 C 之间，C 在 D 和 F 之间；DE 是三角形 DEF 的一条边，因此 ∠EDC 是以 D 为顶点、由 DE 和 DC 构成的角，而 DC 与 DF 在同一直线上同向，所以 ∠EDC 与三角形 DEF 的内角 ∠EDF 相同。推理：由题给 △ABC ≅ △DEF，按字母顺序对应关系为 A ↔ D，B ↔ E，C ↔ F。因此 △ABC 中的 ∠A 对应 △DEF 中的 ∠D，即 ∠EDF。已知 ∠A = 65°，所以 ∠EDF = 65°。又因为 ∠EDC = ∠EDF，所以 ∠EDC = 65°。

method.method_draft: Interpret the figure as two congruent triangular shapes placed along the same baseline. Visually, the angle being asked, ∠EDC, is formed by the slanted side DE and the baseline ray from D through C toward F, so it is the included angle at the left base vertex of triangle DEF. From the congruence statement, triangle ABC can be matched to triangle DEF by a rigid motion with A landing on D, B landing on E, and C landing on F. A rigid motion preserves angle measures, so the left base angle at A of triangle ABC has the same measure as the left base angle at D of triangle DEF. Since ∠A = 65°, ∠EDC = 65°.
